contractRules.targetMeasured: Total runs scored by the nominated batting team in their single respective innings (e.g. Innings 1 or Innings 2)
completionRequirements: Innings reaches maximum legal overs (20.0 overs for T20)
OR live score crosses Over/Under threshold (irreversible outcome)
contractRules.matchCompletionDependency: None. The 2nd innings of the match has zero contractual or mathematical effect on the 1st innings total runs of Team 1.

settlementPolicy: Once the relevant team's innings has concluded or the threshold has been crossed in-play, the total score for that team is final and immutable. Settlement authorization proceeds under snapshot finality rules.
